info.title: melonDS Switch
info.author: FrcJules
info.description: Nintendo DS emulator, JIT, no BIOS
info.details: Unofficial Switch port of the latest melonDS core, not affiliated with the melonDS team. JIT, 2x GPU rendering, no BIOS needed. Auto CPU boost, touch screen via right stick + R3 (TV mode), per-game settings, 4 save state slots. 60 fps in Mario Kart DS, Pokemon, NSMB, Layton, Metroid Prime Hunters. Run hbmenu in app mode (hold R). No games included. Discord: rateur42\n\nAI use: Co-written with AI. AI also used for: description text.

changelog: First public release: JIT, GLES3 2x renderer, CPU Auto, touch cursor, per-game settings, compressed save states.
